from pathlib import Path
import fcntl,os,subprocess,sys,time,traceback
from experiments.offline_camera_retrain_v1.ops import ego_scene_evaluation as e
out=e.review.BASE/'runs/native30_ego_scene_fusion_v2/gate1000'
trial=out.parent
module='experiments.offline_camera_retrain_v1.ops.ego_scene_evaluation'
record=dict(protocol='fixed-dev-gate1000-sequential-evaluation-v1',status='waiting_training',started_at=e.review.common.now(),pid=os.getpid(),stage_updates=1000,expected_predictions=72,cohort_panel='dev',diffusion_seed_index=0,TEST_used=False,confirmation_evaluated=False,automatic_training_extension=False,events=[])
def save(): e.write(out/'PIPELINE.json',record)
def child(command,*options):
 argv=[sys.executable,'-u','-m',module,command,'--out',str(out),*map(str,options)]
 event=dict(command=argv,status='running',started_at=e.review.common.now());record['events'].append(event);record['status']=command;save()
 with (out/(command+'.log')).open('a') as stream:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=e.review.common.ROOT,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONUNBUFFERED='1'),stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  event['pid']=proc.pid;save();result=proc.wait()
 event.update(status='completed' if result==0 else 'failed',returncode=result,ended_at=e.review.common.now());save()
 e.require(result==0,'Gate child failed: '+command)
with (out/'driver.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 try:
  e.require(e.sha256(e.__file__)=='09e0e896c641f5d9a6307018c707952bbadc4ced7a3a6fd8de19b13cedf80a16','Evaluator source changed')
  deadline=time.monotonic()+6*3600
  while True:
   p=e.read(trial/'PIPELINE.json');a=e.read(trial/'MATCHED_AUDIT.json')
   statuses={arm:e.read(trial/arm/'STATUS.json') for arm in ('control','fusion')}
   record['training_snapshot']=dict(pipeline_status=p['status'],updates={arm:status.get('step') for arm,status in statuses.items()},audit_status=a['status'],audit_updates=a['updates_per_arm'],checked_at=e.review.common.now());save()
   e.require(p['status']!='failed','Training pipeline failed')
   if p['status']=='completed':
    e.require(p['stop_step']==1000 and p['final_steps']==dict(control=1000,fusion=1000),'Training boundary differs')
    e.require(a['status']=='passed' and a['updates_per_arm']==1000 and a['plan_sha256']==e.sha256(trial/'PLAN.json'),'Matched1000 audit missing or different')
    e.require(a['physics_OFF_both'] and a['parent_step']==41000,'Training protocol differs')
    break
   e.require(time.monotonic()<deadline,'Timed out waiting for1000 training audit')
   os.kill(p['pid'],0)
   time.sleep(30)
  cohort=e.verify_cohort(e.DEFAULT_COHORT)
  source=e.read(Path(cohort['source'])/'PLAN.json')
  models=dict(base41k=dict(source['models']['candidate41k'],architecture='original',arms=['learned_only']))
  for arm,architecture in [('control','original'),('fusion','scene_fusion_v2')]:
   checkpoint=trial/arm/'training/last.pt'
   e.require(e.sha256(checkpoint)==a['checkpoint_sha256'][arm],'Checkpoint differs from matched audit')
   models[arm]=dict(checkpoint=str(checkpoint.resolve()),checkpoint_sha256=a['checkpoint_sha256'][arm],expected_step=1000,architecture=architecture,arms=['learned_only'])
  registry=out/'INPUT_MODELS.json';e.write(registry,models)
  record['training_pipeline_sha256']=e.sha256(trial/'PIPELINE.json');record['matched_audit_sha256']=e.sha256(trial/'MATCHED_AUDIT.json');save()
  child('prepare','--models',registry,'--panel','dev','--seed-index','0','--arms','learned_only')
  plan=e.read(out/'PLAN.json')
  e.require(plan['planned_predictions']==72 and len(plan['entries'])==12 and all(x['review_panel']=='dev' for x in plan['entries']),'Wrong dev gate cohort')
  e.require(all(plan['models'][arm]['stage_plan_sha256']==a['plan_sha256'] for arm in ('control','fusion')),'Candidate training stage differs')
  record['plan_sha256']=e.sha256(out/'PLAN.json');save()
  child('evaluate','--resume','--memory-fraction','.65')
  child('recheck')
  proof=e.read(out/'CPU_RECHECK.json')
  e.require(proof['status']=='independent_cpu_passed' and proof['predictions']==72 and not proof['CUDA_initialized'],'CPU gate recheck failed')
  record.update(status='completed',ended_at=e.review.common.now(),completed_predictions=72,CPU_recheck_sha256=e.sha256(out/'CPU_RECHECK.json'),rows_sha256=e.sha256(out/'rows.jsonl'));save()
 except BaseException as exc:
  record.update(status='failed',ended_at=e.review.common.now(),error=repr(exc));save();traceback.print_exc();raise
policy: Wait for completed matching1000 audit, then prepare pinned12dev clean/noisy three-model72 predictions and independent CPU recheck; no training extension or confirmation evaluation.
